text: {"lessons":["Judge trades by the business and price trend, not by my average cost; losses alone are not a reason to sell, nor gains a reason to sell too early.","Avoid reacting to short-term moves with frequent, inconsistent trades; set a clear reason and plan for each buy or sale.","Keep positions and cash balanced, and limit how much any one stock can affect the account; recent gains and losses show the value of managing risk."]}
